mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (indicating accommodative monetary policy) compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC for FEDFUNDS predicting 20-day SPX returns is less than 0.03 in any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 4.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing corporate earnings expectations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 4.0% (based on 2000-2023 data).

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent decline in housing starts and real personal consumption expenditures indicates a severe demand contraction, reducing corporate revenue visibility and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline (based on 2000-2023 data).

mechanism_narrative: In low-inflation environments (CPIAUCSL < 2.5%), a lower federal funds rate compresses discount rates and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods when CPIAUCSL < 2.5%, the Rank IC for FEDFUNDS predicting 20-day SPX returns is less than 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 100 (index, 2017=100) signals a severe manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate output and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100 (based on 2000-2023 data).

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of nonfarm employment supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC for PAYEMS predicting 60-day SPX returns is less than 0.03 in any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent decline in real GDP growth (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates a deepening recession, causing immediate negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both GDPC1 and HOUST decline (based on 2000-2023 data).

mechanism_narrative: In monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), an elevated federal funds rate raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, the Rank IC for FEDFUNDS predicting 60-day SPX returns is greater than or equal to -0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
